goal: Refactor DAL toward workspace-local autonomous improvement with native subscription execution and portable tokenless distribution.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All release packages work in a clean consumer without a DAL checkout.
Release configuration uses committed versions, tested artifacts and tokenless trusted publishing.
Terminal record identities and interleaved tool attribution support reliable evidence enrollment.
A bounded comparison core preserves goal hypotheses, resumes, validates pinned history and distinguishes evaluated, eligible and simulated-retained candidates.
A campaign autonomously discovers hypotheses, generates and executes candidates through native DSH, and activates or rolls back workspace generations.
The requested workspace completes a live authorized improvement cycle with independently measured results.
The updated release is published through the configured npm trusted publisher.
Focused tests, repository checks and installed-package replay pass.

outcome.summary: Portable distribution, evidence repairs and deterministic campaign replay are implemented and verified; the requested live autonomous loop remains incomplete.

exception.reason: Campaign authority, native subscription execution, automatic hypothesis and candidate construction, and isolated activation and rollback are not implemented. Current exact-action rules and missing runtime evidence do not permit treating replay as live promotion. Registry trust and release execution are also pending.
exception.next_action: Implement and review the campaign authority contract and native confined executor, prove cold-start activation and rollback, then prepare exact authorized workspace and release operations. Use the roadmap integration sequence.

what_worked: Seven release tarballs passed a clean-consumer test including complete deterministic campaign replay.
The repository gate passed with 1217 tests and seven explicitly skipped integration tests.
Replay separates proxy gains, qualification regressions, eligible selection and actual non-activation.
Read-only workspace diagnostics reported evidence presence without inferring authentication or runtime assurance.
Human source review preceded the capsule refresh.
what_failed: The full live autonomy acceptance criterion remains unsatisfied.
The first post-documentation gate detected a stale capsule test date and a second changed source pin; both were reconciled before the final passing gate.

calls.name: clean-consumer-verification
calls.purpose: Verify packaged runtime assets and campaign replay without a source checkout.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The comparison core has no live campaign executor or activation boundary.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Complete the native executor and authority integration before claiming an autonomous loop.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: A linked roadmap capsule and fixed test date required reconciliation after the reviewed documentation changes.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Review all affected capsule source references together when updating canonical contracts.

evidence.summary: Seven built artifacts passed clean-consumer executable, asset, import, package-resolution and full replay checks.
Portable packaging and OIDC configuration are implemented locally; registry account setup and publication were not executed.
Recorder tests cover stage identity, checkpoint exclusion and bounded call-identity attribution.
Seven focused replay tests cover resume, budgets, drift, qualification, no-change and non-authorizing results.

Final repository gate passed 1217 tests with seven opt-in skips; capsule, policy and both offline scorecards passed. Read-only target-workspace diagnostics are summarized separately from runtime proof.
Lists unimplemented live authority, subscription execution, objective construction, confinement, activation, rollback and pilot work.

uncertainty.statement: No live subscription, runtime isolation, candidate execution or promotion evidence was produced.
uncertainty.resolution: Complete the missing executor and perform a separately authorized native integration.

uncertainty.statement: GitHub OIDC publication has not been exercised for the new release set.
uncertainty.resolution: Configure package-side trusted publishers and perform the reviewed release operation.

notes: The user approved source capsule refresh; this is not approval of live execution, mounting, promotion or publication.
